name: What is the process for repairing a broken water line?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for repairing a broken water line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our repair process begins with a thorough inspection using advanced leak detection equipment to accurately locate the break. Once pinpointed, we'll discuss the best repair method, which might involve excavation for a traditional repair or trenchless techniques depending on the damage and location. Our technicians will then perform the repair, which could include patching, clamping, or replacing a section of the pipe. After the repair, we test the line to ensure integrity and restore your property with minimal disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: We locate the break using detection equipment, then discuss repair options like excavation or trenchless methods. We repair, test, and restore the area.
